changes.title: Discover UniProt graph identities through service metadata
changes.claim: A mediated service-description read followed by local SPARQL produced a complete graph-name inventory. Use the official catalog and per-graph documentation to orient queries; do not infer graph names solely from vocabulary namespaces. A catalog read is not schema extraction or proof of endpoint reasoning support.
changes.applicability: Source-owned RDF service descriptions, native retained RDF and bounded local projections. Keep source version/hash and distinguish advertised metadata from queried data. Resource guide and retrospective limits: artifacts/wiki-learning/scientific/uniprot-discovery-20260920-capture/README.md (companion documentation, not additional validated corpus evidence).

changes.title: Respect bounded projections when inspecting a graph catalog
changes.claim: A display limit of 30 was rejected with LS_BOUND_EXCEEDED (maximum 10). A subsequent fresh capture paged in batches of ten and checked all catalog rows. The first kernel was closed; this is NOT evidence of same-handle recovery or that an earlier remote query succeeded.
changes.applicability: Distinguish presentation-bound errors from network timeouts. Inspect typed repair information; page within the documented limit without adding SPARQL LIMIT merely to fit the prompt.
